skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the geographical approaches to economic activities and their spatial distribution.
Comprehend the economic theories and concepts in the context of global economic geography.
Analyze the impact of globalization on economic activities and spatial organization.
Develop research skills to analyze and interpret economic geography data.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate economic geography theories and their practical applications.
Enhance communication skills to present economic geography findings effectively.
Work collaboratively in teams to solve economic geography problems.
Utilize problem-solving techniques to address economic geography challenges.
Foster self-learning and independent study habits in economic geography.
Conduct spatial analysis to understand economic activities and their distribution.
Analyze case studies to understand economic geography concepts and their practical applications.
Use GIS to analyze and visualize economic geography data.
Evaluate the sustainability of economic activities from a geographical perspective.
Understand urban economic concepts and their spatial organization.
Analyze global trade patterns and their impact on economic geography.
Understand the role of financial markets in economic geography.
Analyze the impact of technology on economic geography.
Understand logistics and its role in economic geography.
Analyze environmental factors in economic geography.
Understand labor economics and its impact on economic geography.
Analyze international economic concepts and their impact on economic geography.
Understand regional economic concepts and their impact on economic geography.
Analyze global value chains and their impact on economic geography.
Understand multinational corporations and their impact on economic geography.
Evaluate sustainable development strategies from an economic geography perspective.
